text:
emily_csm: FYI — incoming from Acuity: after the v2 canary rolled yesterday their generated deploy script is failing CI. They say a finalization step is missing from the output (used to be there). stack trace attached. Can someone triage? :warning:

devon_support: Can you paste the exact generated snippet + the customer prompt? Also which model variant they were on (genassist-v2, genassist-v2-quant, etc.)?

emily_csm: Pasting customer excerpt and the failing log. They were on genassist-v2 (canary rollout at 2026-03-10 03:40 UTC).

Customer message:
"""
Prompt: "Generate a deployment script that builds, runs tests, and calls finalize() on the release manager.
Provide a bash script that ensures cleanup on failure."

Generated (incorrect):
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e
npm install
npm run build
npm test
# MISSING: call to finalize/release manager
exit 0
```

CI failing log:
```
> npm run build
> node ./scripts/release.js
Error: release manager: not finalized
    at Object.start (./scripts/release.js:23:15)
    at processTicksAndRejections (internal/process/task_queues.js:95:5)
```
"""

marta_eng_ml: thanks. Quick thought: sounds like a step-dropping regression (model omitted an explicit call). Could be a prompt-to-output truncation or decoder-behavior change after a kernel update. Do we have the original request payload (full input, temperature, max_tokens)?

emily_csm: Attached request metadata from the ticket:
```json
{"model":"genassist-v2","temperature":0.0,"max_tokens":512,"input":"Generate a deployment script that builds, runs tests, and calls finalize() on the release manager. Provide a bash script that ensures cleanup on failure."}
```

lisa_csm: I tried with the same payload against prod genassist-v2 and reproduced the omission. Lowering temperature to 0 didn't help. I then tested genassist-v1 and it included finalize() as expected. So this looks like a regression introduced in v2 behavior.

ben_runtime: tagging runtime: :eyes: Can you include the model_revision/hash? Also did the canary include any decoding/penalty changes or top_p tweaks? If it's deterministic at temp=0.0 we might have a change in the tokenization cutoff or post-processing filter that strips a specific token sequence (eg. finalizer function name).

emily_csm: Model revision in ticket header: genassist-v2@2026-03-09. Canary rollout started 2026-03-10. Customer gave us the raw response body:
```json
{"id":"resp_abc123","output":"#!/usr/bin/env bash\nset -e\nnpm install\nnpm run build\nnpm test\n# note: cleanup done by exit hook\nexit 0\n"}
```

marta_eng_ml: can you repro locally with the exact model_revision? I'll run a diff between v1 and v2 outputs on our eval harness. If v2 consistently drops the explicit finalize call, we need to bisect commit/weights.

devon_support: Are there other customers reporting similar missing finalization or omitted steps? If it's widespread we should consider pausing rollout.

lisa_csm: Quick check across our customer tickets — I see 2 other repos reporting omitted explicit teardown/finalize steps in generated scripts since the v2 canary. Not high volume but definitely a pattern (scripts missing explicit release.finalize() or `cleanup()` invocations).

ben_runtime: Action items from runtime side: 1) capture a few failing request/responses (we have one), 2) run the same prompt across model_revisions v2@prev and v2@2026-03-09 to pinpoint regression window, 3) check if any post-processing filters (safety/text-normalization) were updated in the canary. I'll open a runtime trace collector job and give link in thread.

sre-bot: New trace job created: trace-job-4829. Please attach logs: request_id resp_abc123, model genassist-v2@2026-03-09.

marta_eng_ml: I ran a quick eval on the prompt set (10 variations). Results: genassist-v1 included finalize() in 9/10; genassist-v2@2026-03-09 included finalize() in 1/10 — big drop. The outputs also show more concise comments and sometimes remove explicit calls in favor of relying on implicit exit hooks. This looks like a change in the decoding preference toward shorter completions.

emily_csm: Customer impact: failing CI for at least 2 customers, risk of more. Customer asked for an ETA to rollback to previous behavior.

ben_runtime: Recommend immediate mitigation: add a simple post-processing rule for codegen routes that reinserts common lifecycle calls (finalize, cleanup, release.finalize) when omitted in pragmatic places — as a short-term fix while ML investigates. Also start a canary rollback if diff confirms v2 revision introduced the regression.

marta_eng_ml: Long-term fix: create a targeted eval + unit test that asserts presence of critical lifecycle calls for codegen prompt families. We'll also bisect model deltas and check training/finetune prompts for a high-level shift (e.g., shorter completions objective).

lisa_csm: I'll notify the affected customers with a short statement: we're investigating, temporary mitigation planned, will update within 6 hours.

devon_support: Thanks — please include repro steps and the example output in the ticket. Mark priority P2 -> escalate to P1 if more customers break.

emily_csm: OK. I'll attach the eval diff and trace link once ready. Thanks folks — ping me in thread if you need access to the Acuity repo snippet. :thumbsup:

ben_runtime: I'll post trace-job output and candidate rollback plan in ~30m.

marta_eng_ml: I'll start bisect now and report findings here.

lisa_csm: Updating customers now.

(emily_csm pinned the message)
